## Correction — two tickets were stranded, not waiting

mg-344a and mg-b8f9 sat `pending` for **two weeks** behind **mg-7d8a**, a shelved time-gate whose
date passed on 14 July. The cause was mechanical and has been **fixed at source** (mg-6ddc): `Create`
parked any item naming a dependency into `pending/`, without checking that parent's state, and
`pending/` is swept only by `Done`. Dependency lookup already spanned `archive/` — **archiving never
stranded anything**, which was the third of three wrong mechanisms diagnosed before anyone read the
code.

I had been relaying both to Daniel as *"pending human action"*, which reads as *the ball is in your
court*. They were mechanically unreachable. **That is a reporting failure of mine, not a delay of
his.**
